milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The andesite stairs span from ~5,~0,~4 to ~7,~2,~6 (spawn-relative). The target is set to the center of the staircase (~6,~1,~5). The player must navigate near the stairs and face them, modeling 'player can see the target'. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the stairs.

Uses inventory_has because mining a polished_andesite_slab with an iron pickaxe causes it to drop as an item that enters the player's inventory. The player starts with no polished_andesite_slab in inventory, so having ≥1 confirms the block was successfully mined. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks per the design philosophy.
